title: Collatz: safe-suffix Lean equivalence and strict rank convexity
body:
## Fifth six-hour checkpoint — 8fd938eb3ef7898a427d8a6c0e501a7777c4a6ec

**Collatz remains open.** Latest guide: [ordinary safe suffixes and strict cycle-rank convexity](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8fd938eb3ef7898a427d8a6c0e501a7777c4a6ec/research/six-hour-20261127/FIFTH_CHECKPOINT.md). [Root review and exact scopes](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8fd938eb3ef7898a427d8a6c0e501a7777c4a6ec/reports/six-hour-20261127/ROOT_REVIEW_WAVE5.md).

- The actual accelerated ordinary map now has a Lean-proved equivalence: every bad odd source has a permanently safe physical suffix, with first entry at most 80 times its bit-length. The final universal prefix-crossing criterion is equivalent to Collatz and remains open.
- A separately reviewed written theorem proves strict convexity of the scaled rank labels for sufficiently long ordinary canonical-height-one cycles, allowing all positive valuations. Every fixed-rank gap is unique. This removes the population-estimate input from the earlier all-lag consumer; subpower rank offsets have stronger explicit mismatch bounds.
- Wider results cover unrestricted positive valuations through discrepancy 2.1, binary cycles through 2.42, finite physical residence and variable-full-denominator physical occupation. Rational resonant lags remain explicitly excluded.
- The critical ordinary trajectory envelope is credited to Inselmann 2024. All four ordinary physical-occupation numerical rows are also recovered from Weaver 181 plus a clock conversion (with the quoted newer irrationality input for the final two); the variable-denominator and elementary-proof distinctions are preserved.
- A genuine local ordinary trajectory refutes the simplest attempted third-difference sign induction.

Fresh verification: **28 Lean modules, 275 theorem axiom audits, 62 finite programs**. Both Python modes reproduce every complete frozen output. All Lean modules rebuilt from source with pinned dependencies, warning-as-error and no unapproved axioms. Clean complete-checkout validator passed at local commit 0ebeaeb716a975a842b02e66ca118095c9a9a2e1; API-published tree exactly matches its tree 2adda6c606519d0c3c6a7b70934992c3dded29f5. The previous full C++ fifth-grid reconstruction is retained at its original scope.

This checkpoint changes 80 files; 71 frozen source identities are preserved in 73 copies, including lossless originals for two whitespace-only prose normalizations. Full asymptotic written proofs and imported analytic theorems are not described as Lean-formalized.

## Fourth checkpoint — certified fifth moment and broader cycle restrictions

**Collatz remains open.** This continues the authorized six-hour research sprint. The new commit is [df2f17a1](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/commit/df2f17a117bea06bb34040a5a97e7dc9711d9871). The complete [checkpoint guide](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/df2f17a117bea06bb34040a5a97e7dc9711d9871/research/six-hour-20261127/FOURTH_CHECKPOINT.md) and [root review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/df2f17a117bea06bb34040a5a97e7dc9711d9871/reports/six-hour-20261127/ROOT_REVIEW_WAVE4.md) separate written proofs, integer certificates, Lean scope, and external inputs.

### Main result

A positive finite certificate proves a fifth absolute moment for the **actual one-variable binary segment source**, uniformly in the cut bits and intercept as the mechanical slope approaches log₂3. Its natural logarithmic rate is at most (4/3)log3 − 1/7000. This crosses the cubic source-counting threshold; the companion barrier explains why every fixed even individual-segment moment misses it in the same full binary model.

The certificate retains 76 dyadic cochains and all 77 mechanical transitions. The entire 252×252 angular grid is evaluated with integer arithmetic, with rational analytic tails and off-grid bounds. The root rebuilt every one of the 10,626 integer row entries; an independent reviewer also rebuilt the grid under undefined-behavior sanitization.

Five actual segments and the fixed-place Subspace separation yield a strict supercubic numerator-height exponent. A separately reviewed extension reaches real discrepancy **W ≤ 2 + 1/100000**, where a genuine third grade can occur. **Finiteness at each fixed denominator additionally uses the quoted preprint μ(log₂3) ≤ 3** (Chudnovsky, arXiv:2610.28079v1, Theorem 11.1). There is no effective onset or classification of the finite exceptions.

### Other reviewed additions

- A 64-letter modular energy certificate reaches binary W ≤ 121/50 and the full limiting physical band max/min ≤ 16/3. It gives numerator-height exponent 5/2 using fixed-place separation, and every proper-lag mismatch density >1/1500 with the separate exponent-three input.
- An arbitrary-width, arbitrary-positive-valuation alternative forces either d > P^(10^-8) or a positive density of canonical grades ≥2 / valuations ≥3. The proof translates the complete actual source before enlarging a positive interval count.
- Two-orientation lag estimates include a classical 2018 logarithmic-form route. The rational clock-gcd result retains the full reduced denominator and credits its ordinary predecessors.
- Sharp all-height statistics on ordinary starting-integer windows, an old-birth-cohort physical ray profile, and an unrestricted small-visitor bound preserve the once-sampled ordinary source. None eliminates a single hypothetical escaping ray.

### Actual verification

- **24 fresh local Lean modules / 224 public and private declaration audits**, pinned Lean and mathlib, standard axioms only.
- **48 finite programs**, complete normal/optimized output reproduction. Optimized replay removes Python assertions; that distinction is recorded.
- **Separate full integer fifth-grid rebuild**, not merely a check of stored rows.
- **97 source/integration identities** and seven integration-artifact hashes; originals retained for location/reporting/display/newline changes.
- Complete clean-checkout integrity validation passed on the local exact tree before publication. The fetched published commit is validated separately.

The new Lean modules prove modular zero-atom domination, projection/record algebra, and exact finite budgets. They do **not** formalize the analytic fifth moment, the numerical grid, the external deep theorems, or the full Collatz conjecture.

## Third six-hour checkpoint — moving shadows, signed grades and binary cycle energy

**Collatz remains OPEN.** This is an ongoing research checkpoint, not a complete proof or the closing report of the six-hour session.

Published head: `2346db2d49030ef385b73e1ee3e27dcbff86d2d9`  
[Third checkpoint guide](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/2346db2d49030ef385b73e1ee3e27dcbff86d2d9/research/six-hour-20261127/THIRD_CHECKPOINT.md) · [Root reconstruction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/2346db2d49030ef385b73e1ee3e27dcbff86d2d9/reports/six-hour-20261127/ROOT_REVIEW_WAVE3.md)

### Mathematical results

- **Moving rational shadows:** a length-\(T\) actual positive orbit window covered by \(k\) exact bounded-height rational tracks or singleton edges satisfies \(T+1\le \exp(C(k+1)/\log(k+2))\log(n+2H+2)\). The argument uses Evertse–Ferretti and permits moving phases and even denominators. A singleton-placement error in the initial draft is corrected; the rejected original and its counterexample are retained.
- **Actual late clocks:** every sufficiently long stack of \(r\) dyadic shells has \(\gg r\log r\) simultaneous shallow dates, uniformly in its starting clock, even on a rapidly growing orbit. Their divergent logarithmic weight connects to the same-source tropical sibling summability of pinned PR 201. The missing cheap-sibling upper bound remains explicit.
- **Signed-grade frontier:** uniform successful-rank count \(O((3/2)^hL/\log L)\), strengthened to \(O((3/2)^hL^{1-1/128})\) using Wu–Wang's actual two-logarithm theorem. A physical-clock split forces a small actual future odd state. Two terminating families give opposite marked-grade answers in every ternary residue class with arbitrarily long common binary prefixes.
- **Narrow binary cycles:** for \(W\le99/50\), binary valuations and \(\log d=o(\log P)\), the full denominator/source bound is \(\liminf\log(dX)/\log P\ge3000/999\). **Source-qualified on Chudnovsky arXiv:2610.28079v1, Theorem 11.1**, the reviewer obtains eventual \(d>P^{1/8000}\), hence fixed-denominator finiteness in this restricted class. No finite exceptions are classified and the onset is ineffective.
- **Fixed-source excursion and method boundary:** the same located count bounds an injective narrow binary excursion from \(A\) by \(O_\varepsilon((A+1)^{999/3000+\varepsilon})\), without the logarithm-ratio preprint. An exact comparison-vector certificate gives near-cubic exponent \(15000/5031\) in the full unforced language and identifies the limitation of this individual fourth-moment bound.

### Verification actually completed

- **21 fresh local Lean modules, 190 public/private axiom audits.** Four new modules cover the terminal precision budget, actual signed/positive split, explicit grade families and the finite six-state energy calculation. Only standard logical axioms occur. External pinned Mathlib objects are reused; project proof objects are rebuilt.
- **27 finite programs** reproduce complete frozen output bytes in normal and optimized Python. Independent controls include 44,036 moving packets, 21,387 native complementary splits, 216 binary phase faces, actual raw reciprocity/carry checks and matrix comparisons.
- **49 source/integration manifest entries and 7 integration artifact hashes.** Original and corrected identities are separate. Mathematical reviews distinguish ordinary sources, changing controls and imported theorems.
- Complete clean-checkout validation passed before publication and again after fetching this exact GitHub commit: **725 tracked files**, tree `71d10240871deed171fcef4913b2ec374a4bd9e8`.
- This checkpoint changes **56 files, 5,782 insertions and 2 deletions**. The prior review and checkpoint history are preserved below.

The analytic conclusions are written proofs with named dependencies. Compiling the finite Lean kernels and passing repository integrity checks do not amount to a proof of Collatz.

## Six-hour continuation — second reviewed checkpoint

**Collatz remains open. Published head: [bf7d52e7](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/commit/bf7d52e78631954a9fd35e4ce973acd27738fc80).** The six-hour session continues. This checkpoint adds 65 changed files and 6,917 insertions after the first checkpoint.

### Mathematical additions

- **Actual positive endpoint reduction and additional inverse budgets.** The positive projection is a full two-way ordinary-path theorem with its source cutoff. A general sharp extra-budget bound and its seven-phase application have Lean proofs. Written results classify the first four extra departures, give a finite dictionary at arbitrary extra budget, and prove protection through R+s+2 whenever the matching-depth principal source is divisible by 3^s. A separate reviewer reconstructed the all-rank finite criterion and all 245 successful small-overhead CRT phase instances.
- **Simultaneous rational-anchor escape.** Exact displacement and Yu's published bound give a shallow clock for all positive rationals of bounded height in each stated window. A signed finite-graph compiler permits even denominators and arbitrary signs; Weaver's adaptive dictionary theorem supplies the stated many-clock deductions. The full positive-height-ball prefix count and its early-window limitation are explicit.
- **Full cycle denominators and ordinary clock constraints.** Moving sparse coefficients, two-ended integral separation and the finite circle mesh give quantitative conditional bounds. Four resonant defects allow a continuum of actual denominator slopes, while other rational cycles have dense defects at every lag and subexponential denominators. All prime powers are retained. These rational controls do not assert integer cycles; existing phase-order restrictions are credited.

[Independent inverse review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bf7d52e78631954a9fd35e4ce973acd27738fc80/reports/six-hour-20261127/INVERSE_WAVE2_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md) · [anchor review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bf7d52e78631954a9fd35e4ce973acd27738fc80/reports/six-hour-20261127/ADAPTIVE_ANCHOR_REVIEW.md) · [cycle review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bf7d52e78631954a9fd35e4ce973acd27738fc80/reports/six-hour-20261127/CYCLE_WAVE2_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md).

Two statement repairs and one finite-output clarification are integrated with exact originals preserved: the anchor set is restricted to its height ball, lifted positive visitors are filtered by the source cutoff, and the spectrum's reported output is distinguished from its internal enumeration.

### Executed verification

- **17 local Lean modules / 160 audited theorem declarations**, including every private helper, freshly rebuilt with warnings-as-errors and automatic implicits disabled. Only standard axioms occur. [Formal receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bf7d52e78631954a9fd35e4ce973acd27738fc80/reports/six-hour-20261127/LEAN_WAVE2_RECEIPT.json).
- **18 finite programs**, each replayed in normal and optimized Python with complete byte comparisons against frozen output. Imported local checker dependencies are hashed. [Control receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/bf7d52e78631954a9fd35e4ce973acd27738fc80/reports/six-hour-20261127/CONTROLS_WAVE2_RECEIPT.json).
- **51 source/review identities and nine integration artifacts** checked, with source-to-correction maps.
- The actual GitHub commit was fetched into a **clean complete 671-file checkout** and passed all five repository integrity commands. Its tree equals the locally validated tree: `99e4cb5e5c3c06292e059214f3785b40374c1d08`.

The analytic and asymptotic arguments remain written, with their external theorem inputs identified. The unresolved universal obligations are a cheaper ordinary visitor for every fixed exceptional source, exclusion of all nontrivial integer cycles, and disappearance of escaping component charge.

### Completed mathematical additions

- **Exact minimum for all seven negative-17 phases:** for every R≥7 and positive cofactor z, the smallest genuine odd source reaching 2·3^R z−t within R accelerated departures is the explicit principal cycle lift. Physical time and each division exponent are unrestricted. Both the shortcut statement and the usual accelerated-map statement have complete Lean proofs. An independent mathematical audit checks the written proof and uniqueness of the attaining history.
- **Quantitative full cycle denominator:** with at most M exceptional cyclic windows, the logarithmic denominator fraction is at least the largest support-gap fraction. A fixed clock gcd quantizes the bound; coprime clocks preserve the full leading denominator. The written proof uses the named outside-place gcd theorem. Exact source/carry anticorrelation explains why fair marginals do not provide independent affine perturbations.

The inverse theorem does not force a cheaper ancestor for every fixed source. The denominator theorem does not cover arbitrary unbounded exception count. The gate calculations do not force normalized retained charge to vanish. Those are active research boundaries.

## Three-hour unconventional sprint — final reviewed packet

**Collatz remains open.** Nine GPT-6.2 Astra workers in three successive teams explored arithmetic on one fixed ordinary trajectory, positive rational cycles, inverse pressure, operators and physical first passages. The integrated written arguments have explicit review and dependency boundaries.

Final commit: [3bda301f](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/commit/3bda301f6fb8c5623bdaa0c1d03dced1d66adfe6). The final wave adds 62 changed files, 6,035 insertions and 18 deletions. The fetched GitHub tree equals the locally validated tree \`c2ede07f1ccd8be01baa4786ab9b2cecad1159d5\`.

### Main outcomes

- The earlier reviewed written pressure proof gives \(r(B_p)=\max(1,3p)\) for \(0<p<1\), hence the classical Bergman transfer radius \(\sqrt{20}/3\), with the stated space and quotient retained. This analytic theorem is not fully formalized.
- On one supplied ordinary path with \(r\) complete resets, the persistent odd divisor satisfies \(g^{r+1}2^{T+t_r}\le C_{r,\epsilon}Y^{1+\epsilon}\). The full gcd of the \(r+1\) shifted boundary values is at most \(Y^{1/(r+1)+o(1)}\). There are sharp ordinary CRT controls, and a refinement using reset-depth ratios. The new written proof uses Evertse's published theorem; the source hypotheses were checked.
- Finite squareclass rank of shifted reset entrances is equivalent to eventual periodicity. At each fixed rank there are only finitely many ordinary cycles. This extends the newly pinned PR192 elementary translate argument to shifted reset boundaries; it does not force finite rank on every orbit.
- Reversing two distinct complete blocks cannot yield an integral compensating entrance at a common terminal satisfying \(3(z+1)\ge x+1\). The written reduction reaches 2,880 exact cases, checked by Lean. Below that floor, an ordinary merger example shows the limitation.
- The finite positive harmonic exit gates have a source-qualified sorted \(\ell^1\) limit equal to weighted escaping-component charges. A vanishing subsequence of their totals would exclude escape; no such bound is proved. This is an endpoint extension of PR201's summable-source gates.
- The exact finite calculation \(B_{14}>B_{13}\) rules out global nonincrease of the centered harmonic sum. Reflection preserves the complete inverse-pressure family while changing the sign-sensitive harmonic head. The underlying harmonic-head identity is prior Weaver Paper 176 work, explicitly credited after the late intake.
- Fixed-modulus cancellation is classified and realized on primitive positive rational cycles while their **full reduced denominators** stay exponentially large. Their real phase values are of order the square of the odd period. These are controls for an ordinary-integer argument, not ordinary counterexamples.

### Verification actually performed

The strict integrated replay rebuilt **22 Lean modules and audited all 147 local theorem declarations** (127 public and 20 private). All reported axioms are standard \`propext\`, \`Classical.choice\`, \`Quot.sound\`, or none. Six third-wave modules add 26 declarations. Large analytic/Diophantine conclusions remain written; conditional closing consumers retain their unproved premises.

[Strict Lean receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3bda301f6fb8c5623bdaa0c1d03dced1d66adfe6/reports/unconventional-20261126/THIRD_LEAN_RECEIPT.json) · [nine complete controls, normal and optimized Python](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3bda301f6fb8c5623bdaa0c1d03dced1d66adfe6/reports/unconventional-20261126/THIRD_CONTROL_REPLAY.json) · [frozen source and integration hashes](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/3bda301f6fb8c5623bdaa0c1d03dced1d66adfe6/reports/unconventional-20261126/THIRD_WAVE_SOURCE_MAP.json).

All nine third-wave finite scripts matched their entire expected records in both Python modes, including two separately written root reviewers. Both independent finite gate implementations agree at seven cutoffs. All 151 packet-relative Markdown links resolve, and all recorded integrated source hashes were checked.

The **fetched published commit** 3bda301f6fb8c5623bdaa0c1d03dced1d66adfe6 passed all five commands of \`tools/validate.py\` on a clean 565-file checkout. This structural validation is separate from mathematical verification.

New heads of PR192, PR193, PR195, PR197 and PR201 were read at the exact pins in the late-intake report. Overlap with PR193's component moments and PR197's affine mergers is credited. No full rebuild of those other branches is claimed. Their explicit remaining global premises are preserved.

The next proof must force a zero escape-gate/harmonic-head limit, or a contradictory arithmetic structure on every fixed exceptional trajectory, and must also exclude nontrivial ordinary cycles. This packet does not claim those steps.

## 26 November broad reevaluation — exact pressure checkpoint

**Collatz remains open.** The second wave gives a complete written calculation of the classical Bergman transfer radius, **sqrt(20)/3**, together with exact inverse pressure, uniform finite prediction and complete ordinary first-descent controls. The root reconstructed the proof and two separately authored reviews found no remaining gap. The full analytic theorem is not yet a Lean formalization.

**Published checkpoint: 67d524a9c74e3a5becdc9abc278a4d7a8cf419f0.** The GitHub tree equals the locally verified tree. The exact remote commit was fetched back into a clean complete checkout and passed all five structural validation commands.

Start with [the second-wave scientific guide](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/67d524a9c74e3a5becdc9abc278a4d7a8cf419f0/research/unconventional-20261126/SECOND_WAVE.md), [the root reconstruction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/67d524a9c74e3a5becdc9abc278a4d7a8cf419f0/reports/unconventional-20261126/ROOT_SECOND_REVIEW.md), [the exact pressure proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/67d524a9c74e3a5becdc9abc278a4d7a8cf419f0/research/unconventional-20261126/operator/EXACT_BERGMAN_PRESSURE.md), and [source identities](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/67d524a9c74e3a5becdc9abc278a4d7a8cf419f0/reports/unconventional-20261126/SECOND_WAVE_SOURCE_MAP.json).

### Mathematical changes

- **Exact biased inverse pressure:** r(B_p)=max(1,3p). The main new step proves that a stationary legal inverse process with genuine conditional branching has full ternary dimension. Countable labels, conditional Bayes probabilities, local independence errors and the entropy-window telescope are treated explicitly.
- **Exact Bergman radius and disk:** r(T)=sqrt(20)/3. On every ordinary component its spectrum and Fredholm essential spectrum are the entire closed disk of that radius. A separate exact positive-vector argument gives an infinite-multiplicity point-spectrum disk of slightly smaller radius. The component spectra agree on the known basin of 1, so this is not a Collatz conclusion.
- **Finite rules and survivor pressure:** finite local rules have exact finite-matrix/cycle pressure. A closed finite-alphabet language S has maximum common ordinary endpoint fiber rate max(0,h_top(S)-log3). The unrestricted shortcut inverse count grows at rate 4/3, with exact odd-proportion rates.
- **Uniform predictor:** one finite ternary rule works uniformly over every admissible word and endpoint under the stated strict entropy hypothesis. An explicit depth-ten certificate proves 9 mistakes <= n+82 for the specified local coefficient-drop language, by checking all 4,111 words and an integer graph potential.
- **Complete ordinary excursion realization:** every stationary legal inverse law of mean <= log_2(3) is a weak limit of complete first-descent excursions of ordinary pairs q,3q that both reach 1. Fixed gap caps give exactly the critical-mean class. This construction exposes the remaining distinction between stationary statistics and one fixed infinite source.
- **All-depth reference capacity:** a Kraft bound limits the proposed smaller-reference route; exact depth-40 density intervals and a terminating family outside reserve one are included.
- **Nonlocal trace:** with explicitly source-qualified canonical-density inputs, actual first-hit power sums identify the sum of positive escape-component charges. An o(n) upper bound that would force those charges to vanish remains unproved, and positive cycles remain a separate obligation.

### Evidence actually executed

- **16 Lean modules; all 121 local theorem declarations audited**, including private helpers. Only standard Lean axioms occur. Two missing pinned Mathlib modules were rebuilt in a temporary mirror.
- The eleven repaired earlier closing interfaces retain their explicit global premises. The full pressure and ergodic arguments are written proofs, not falsely counted as formal theorems.
- **Five second-wave primary controls and four independent controls** reproduced complete JSON in both normal and optimized Python.
